correction.issue: The first published external baselines leaked the case labels into the agent workspace.
correction.cause: scripts/run_harness_baseline.py staged the audit tree and then wrote the per-case dataset manifest, including the `expected` labels, into the same directory used as the agent's working directory. Codex and others read it, so results such as Codex 21/21 exact were not independent discovery.
correction.fix: scripts/external_agent.py --hide-labels moves dataset.json out of the workspace for the duration of each harness run and restores it afterwards; the runner passes it by default. The clean window showed zero manifest reads.
correction.superseded: The deepseek-flash 'samemodel-*' runs (Codex 21/21, Claude 21/21, DSH 20/21, Pi 19/21) and the earlier mixed-model runs are invalid for detection and retained only in git history.
